title: EvoLink-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Self-Evolving Agents in Long-Horizon Interdependent Task Streams
abstract: arXiv:2611.34400v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from passive chatbots into autonomous systems that operate continuously in dynamic environments. Such agents need not only solve current tasks but also learn from past interactions to improve future performance. However, existing streaming benchmarks often rely on short task sequences or largely independent tasks, providing limited evidence of whether agents can effectively reuse experience when later tasks depend on earlier outcomes. It covers daily office work, multi-turn dialogue, and AutoResearch-style workflows, with persistent workspaces and dependencies across tasks. translated_title: EvoLink-Bench：一个用于评估自进化智能体在长周期相互依赖任务流中的基准测试
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体正在从被动的聊天机器人演变为在动态环境中持续运行的自主系统。这类智能体不仅需要解决当前任务，还需要从过去的交互中学习，以提升未来的表现。然而，现有的流式基准测试往往依赖较短的任务序列或彼此基本独立的任务，对于智能体能否在后续任务依赖先前结果时有效复用经验，所提供的证据十分有限。为填补这一空白，我们提出了 EvoLink-Bench，一个用于评估自进化智能体在长周期相互依赖任务流中表现的基准。该基准涵盖日常办公工作、多轮对话以及 AutoResearch 风格的工作流，并配备持久化工作区和跨任务依赖关系。基准包含两个互补的评估层级：L1 评估可语言表达知识的获取与修订，L2 则评估……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出 EvoLink-Bench 基准，通过具有持久工作区和跨任务依赖关系的长周期任务流，从可语言表达知识的获取与修订（L1）以及更深层的进化能力（L2）两个互补层级，评估自进化智能体复用历史经验并持续改进的能力。
en_tdlr: EvoLink-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating self-evolving LLM agents on long-horizon interdependent task streams, using persistent workspaces with cross-task dependencies and two complementary levels (L1 for acquiring and revising language-expressible knowledge, L2 for assessing further evolutionary capabilities).
